content: Jesús, Nicodemo-ebo sunmaksad
Dule-wargwen Fariseo-sorda, Nicodemoʼye-nugadi, Judíoʼmar-abargi nue-nug-nika gudigusad.

We-dulede, mutik Jesúsʼse nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Rabí, odurdaked-saila-dummad, anmar wisid, be anmar-odurdakegala Bab-Dummad be-barmialid. Ar Bab-Dummad we-duleba gudisulile, we-dule gege ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad imaked.
Jesús, Nicodemo-abin-imakded, ega sogded: —Napira an bega soged, dule gannar gwalulesulile, gege Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid daked.
Nicodemo Jesúsʼse egisdesunnad: —¿Ar igi dule-sered gannar gwalulegosunna? ¿Ar sunna gannar gwalulegega e-nan-nukugi gannar megosi?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napira an bega soged, ar dule diigi, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesulile, gege Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse doged.
Ar dule wegi-sanale gwalulesale, we, sanaledgadid. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesardi, we, burbaledgadid.
Degisoggu, mer geg be itoge, an bega soged: Be gannar gwalulegergebye.
”Burwa-goledi e-itolegedba goled, unnila, e-goledbi be itoged. Burwa-danikiddi be wissulid, degi, be wissurbalid, bia nadapbali. Deyobmodo, dule Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulesar.”
Nicodemo, Jesús-abin-sogded: —¿Wede, igi gusunna?
Jesús, Nicodemo-abin-sogded: —Bede Israel-dulemar-odurdakedsailadde, ¿we-igar amba be aku itode?
Napira an bega soged, anmar ibmar-wisidba sunmakmalad. Anmar ibmar-daksadba sogmalad, degi-inigwele, bemar anmar-ibmar-bega-sogedi yapa be abingamalad.
Ar ibmar-we-napnegginmaladgi an bemarga sunmaksad, degite, be benmalad. ¿Ar igi be bengussurmalarsunna an bega ibmar-nibneggined sogdemalar? Be bengusmalaled.
”Dule nibnegse gwen nakwissulid, unnila, ani Dule-Machibi nibneggi-mai aidenonikid.
”Ar igi Moisés nega-dulesulidganba naibe-onakwisgusa, debayobi, ani Dule-Machi, nakrusgi niba onailemogargebed.
Adi, doa-dule angi bengussulile, mer yogguega, burba-geg-bergued angi nikuegar.”
Bab-Dummad dule-we-napneggi-bukwad nue-sabgusad

“Ar Bab-Dummad bela we-napneggi-dule-bukwad nue-sabgussoggu, E-Machi-Wargwenna-Guedi barmialid, adi, dulemar-isgued-anar burgwegar. Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensuli-gunonikile, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed, adi, mer bar degisadegu, sabsur-odurdaklesii guegar.
Ar Bab-Dummad we-napnegse na E-Machi-barmiargu, dule-we-napneggi-bukmalad-sabsur-odurdakega barmiarsulid. Na E-Machi-barmialid, adi, dule-we-napneggi-bukmalad E-Machigi abonolemalagar.
”Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensulile, we-dule sabsur-odurdaklegosulid. Ar dule, Bab-Dummad-Machi-Wargwenna-Gued-e-nuggi-benerdi, bato ega sabsur-odurdakleged-igar maid.
”Gwallu-meegwad we-napnegse nonikid. Degi-inigwele, dulemar bur ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-ulale, bur gwallu-meegwadba negsichid sabgusmalad. A-ular, dulemar sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
”Ar bela dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladi, gwallu-meegwad isdar dakdamalad, gwalluse dagbisurdamalad, adi, melle e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiid neg-meegwadse osanalolegegar.
”Ar dule igar-napiragwad-imakdiiddina, gwalluse nonidamalad, adi, e-ibmar-imakdiid na oyogega, ede Bab-Dummadba ibsadiiye.”
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan gannar Jesúsʼgi sunmaksabalid
A-sorbali, Jesús e-sapinganmala Judea-yalase nadmalad. Agi undar gudii gusmalad, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdii gusad.
Deunni, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan Salim-neggwebur-walik, Enón-neg-nugadgi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknai gusmogad, ar ade, agi dii wilarbad. Dulemar Bab-Dummad-diigi-oglegega Juanʼse nonigusmalad.
Ar deunni, amba yoo Juan esgaryagi melleged.
Agi Juan-sapingan Judíoʼmar-ebo swilidik-gued-igargi abin-abin imakarmalad.

Juan-sapingan, e-dummad-Juanʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Odurdaked-saila, dule-Jordán-diwar-obakar-beba-gudigusad, egi be nued-sunmaksad, a-dule, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imaknaimogad. Dule-bukidar ese duurmaknadapmalad. Degisoggu, be sordamar-sate guoed.
Juan, e-sapingan-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ar dule Bab-Dummad-ega-ibmar-uksulile, gege ibmar nikued.
Ar bemar-sunnad an-itosmalad, an sogsagu: ‘Ani an Cristoʼsurye, andi unnila e-idu-igar-mayega barmilearye.’

”Ar ome-nikulenaid-ibagi, dule-ome-nikunaidbi ome-nikuoed. Ar machered-e-aidi, e-dikarba-gwichid, unnila sui-e-sunmaked-itogwichid. Weligwar sui-ibmar-soggwichid itogwichid. Emigindi, an dule-ome-nikunaid-e-aiyobmogad. An nue-weligwar itomogad.
Jesús-nug bur dunguergebed, andi bur nug-bipii guergebed.”
Jesús nibneggi danikid

Diigi-dule-oged-Juan sogdebalid: “Ar dule-nibneggi-danikidi, bela dulemargi obined. Dule-napneggineddi, unnila napnegginedid, napneggined-ibmarbi sunmaked. Ar dule-nibneggi-danikiddi, bela dulemargi obined.
”We-dule-nibneggi-danikidi nibneggi-ibmar-daksadba, degi, nibneggi-ibmar-itosadba, sunmaked. Degite, dulemar a-dule gwen-itobisurmalad.
Ar dule, dule-nibneggi-danikid-sunmaked abingaele, we sognaido, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-soged, napiraye.
Ar Bab-Dummad we-dule-barmiarsoggu, a-ulale, we-dule-nibneggi-danikidi, Bab-Dummad-e-gayaburba sunmaked. Ar Bab-Dummad E-Burba ise-obinagwar uked, ise-wilubsaar uksulid.
”Ar Bab-Dummad nue na e-Machi-sabsoggu, bela ibmar E-Machiga uksasunnad.

”Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bensuli-gunonikile, a-dule, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi bengunonikirdi, burba-geg-bergued gwen nikuosulid. Aka bur Bab-Dummad-dule-sabsur-odurdaked-igar itogoed.”
